name: git-workflow
description: PR and issue workflow toolkit: pr-triage / pr-loop / issue-triage / issue-loop skills plus a local review-desk dashboard that computes the triage grid, the chase blocks, the merge gate and the issue cross-check itself, calling a model only for what needs judgement. The loops take the numbers to work and a batch size, so several can be proposed together and executed in parallel worktrees. Pluggable git hosting providers (GitHub today, Forgejo ready).
